# // Reference frames from OyenKit (the Swift port) for poni-core's Rust port of Oyen's face.
# // Built in one module with OyenKit's own sources, so internals are reachable.
# // Usage: oyen-dump fixture <out.txt> <this main.swift>   compact, decimal numbers: poni-core's test fixture,
# //                                                        with this program appended as comments
# //        oyen-dump full <out.txt>                        every frame at 60 fps and more, numbers as bit
# //                                                        patterns, for a diff with poni-core's own dump
# // Build: swiftc -O -module-name OyenKit <OyenKit>/OyenFace.swift <OyenKit>/OyenGeometry.swift \
# //          <OyenKit>/OyenMarkData.swift <OyenKit>/OyenSVG.swift main.swift -o oyen-dump

#     case .decimal: return "\(v)"
#     case .bits: return String(v.bitPattern, radix: 16)

# }
#
# func paintName(_ p: OyenPaint) -> String {

# }
